title: 東西被偷了怎麼報案
subtitle: 12 句英文，兩分鐘把話講清楚

lines.say: Garda station, how can I help?
lines.zh: 這裡是警察局，有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

lines.say: My bag! A man! Bus! Gone!
lines.zh: 我的包包！一個男的！公車！不見了！

lines.say: That was me. Someone took my bag on the bus, and when I got to the station, my English disappeared too.
lines.zh: 那就是我。包包在公車上被拿走，我到了警局，英文也跟著不見了。

lines.say: The garda was very kind, but it took twenty minutes to explain a ten second story.
lines.zh: 警察人很好，但一個十秒鐘的故事，我花了二十分鐘才講完。

board.cta: 東西被偷了怎麼報案・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! I hope you never need today's lesson. But if you do, you'll be ready.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！希望你永遠用不到今天這一課。但萬一需要，你會準備好。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! I hope you never need today's lesson. But if you do, you'll be ready.

lines.say: Twelve sentences to report a theft: what happened, what was taken, and what happens next.
lines.zh: 十二句話報案：發生什麼事、什麼被偷、接下來怎麼辦。

lines.say: First, one word. In Ireland the police are called the Gardaí.
lines.zh: 先講一個字。在愛爾蘭，警察叫做 Gardaí。

lines.say: One officer is a garda, and the police station is the garda station.
lines.zh: 一位警察叫 garda，警察局就是 garda station。

scenes.title: What happened
scenes.sub: 說經過：先講重點，再講細節

lines.say: Part one: say what happened.
lines.zh: 第一段：說明經過。

lines.say: When you're stressed, you tell the story from the very beginning. Don't. Start with the headline.
lines.zh: 人一緊張，就會從頭開始講。不要這樣，先講標題。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: I'd like to report a theft.
scenes.meaning: 我要報案，我東西被偷了
scenes.note: report a theft ＝ 報竊盜案

lines.say: I'd like to report a theft.
To report means to tell the police officially. A theft is when something is stolen.
lines.zh: report 是正式向警方通報，theft 是竊盜。

lines.say: With this one sentence, the garda knows exactly which form to open.
lines.zh: 光這一句，警察就知道要開哪一張表格。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'd like to report a theft.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: My bag was stolen on the bus about an hour ago.
scenes.meaning: 我的包包大約一小時前在公車上被偷了
scenes.note: was stolen ＝ 被偷（被動語態）

lines.say: Then: what, where, and when, all in one sentence.
lines.zh: 接著一句話講完：什麼東西、在哪裡、什麼時候。

lines.say: My bag was stolen on the bus about an hour ago.
We say was stolen, the passive, because we don't know who did it.
lines.zh: 用被動的 was stolen，因為我們不知道是誰偷的。

lines.say: What, where, when. Say it in that order and you sound calm, even if you're not.
lines.zh: 什麼、哪裡、何時。照這個順序說，就算你不冷靜，聽起來也很冷靜。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: My bag was stolen on the bus about an hour ago.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: I only realised it was gone when I got off.
scenes.meaning: 我下車的時候才發現不見了
scenes.note: I only realised… when ＝ 直到……才發現

lines.say: Often you didn't see it happen. Here's how to say that.
lines.zh: 很多時候你根本沒看到過程。這時候這樣說。

lines.say: I only realised it was gone when I got off.
I only realised when means: I didn't know until that moment.
lines.zh: I only realised… when 意思是：直到那一刻我才發現。

lines.say: It was gone means it wasn't there any more.
lines.zh: it was gone 是東西已經不在了。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I only realised it was gone when I got off.

scenes.title: Describe it
scenes.sub: 講特徵：東西和人都要描述

lines.say: Part two: describe it.
lines.zh: 第二段：描述特徵。

lines.say: The garda will ask two things: what does the bag look like, and did you see anyone?
lines.zh: 警察會問兩件事：包包長什麼樣子？你有看到誰嗎？

lines.say: In English, describing words have an order: size, then colour, then material, then the thing.
lines.zh: 英文的形容詞有順序：大小、顏色、材質，最後才是東西。

lines.say: So it's a small black leather backpack. Any other order sounds strange.
lines.zh: 所以是 a small black leather backpack，換個順序聽起來就怪。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: It's a small black leather backpack with a broken zip.
scenes.meaning: 是一個小的黑色皮革後背包，拉鍊壞了
scenes.note: with ＋ 特別的地方，最好認

lines.say: It's a small black leather backpack with a broken zip.
After the basics, add with, and one special detail.
lines.zh: 講完基本資料，加上 with，再講一個特別的地方。

lines.say: The special detail is what helps them find it. Thousands of bags are black.
lines.zh: 特別的地方才找得到，黑色的包包有幾千個。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: It's a small black leather backpack with a broken zip.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: It had my passport, my wallet and my phone in it.
scenes.meaning: 裡面有我的護照、錢包和手機
scenes.note: It had … in it ＝ 裡面有……

lines.say: Now, what was inside?
lines.zh: 接著，裡面有什麼？

lines.say: It had my passport, my wallet and my phone in it.
It had something in it. Don't forget the little in it at the end.
lines.zh: It had… in it，最後的 in it 不要漏掉。

lines.say: Start with the most important thing. For most of us, that's the passport.
lines.zh: 從最重要的講起。對大部分的人來說是護照。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: It had my passport, my wallet and my phone in it.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: I didn't get a good look at him, but he was wearing a grey hoodie.
scenes.meaning: 我沒看清楚他的長相，但他穿灰色連帽衣
scenes.note: get a good look at ＝ 看清楚

lines.say: And if you saw someone, but not clearly, say this.
lines.zh: 如果你有看到人，但沒看清楚，就這樣說。

lines.say: I didn't get a good look at him, but he was wearing a grey hoodie.
Get a good look at means see someone clearly.
lines.zh: get a good look at 是把某人看清楚。

lines.say: It's fine not to be sure. Never guess. Just say what you really saw.
lines.zh: 不確定沒關係，千萬不要亂猜，只講你真的看到的。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I didn't get a good look at him, but he was wearing a grey hoodie.
Listen to how the garda asks, and how I answer.
lines.zh: 聽聽警察怎麼問，我怎麼回答。

lines.say: Can you describe the bag for me?
lines.zh: 你可以描述一下那個包包嗎？

lines.say: It's a small black leather backpack with a broken zip.
lines.zh: 是一個小的黑色皮革後背包，拉鍊壞了。

lines.say: And what was in it?
lines.zh: 裡面有什麼？

lines.say: It had my passport, my wallet and my phone in it.
lines.zh: 裡面有我的護照、錢包和手機。

lines.say: Did you see who took it?
lines.zh: 你有看到是誰拿的嗎？

lines.say: I didn't get a good look at him, but he was wearing a grey hoodie.
lines.zh: 我沒看清楚他的長相，但他穿灰色連帽衣。

lines.say: Clear answers, and no guessing.
lines.zh: 回答清楚，而且不亂猜。

scenes.title: What I need
scenes.sub: 要文件：保險和補辦都靠它

lines.say: Part three: get what you need.
lines.zh: 第三段：拿到你需要的東西。

lines.say: Many people report the theft, say thank you, and leave. Then the insurance company asks for a number they don't have.
lines.zh: 很多人報完案、說聲謝謝就走了。結果保險公司跟你要一個你沒有的號碼。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: Could I get a crime reference number for my insurance?
scenes.meaning: 可以給我報案編號嗎？保險要用
scenes.note: crime reference number ＝ 報案編號

lines.say: Could I get a crime reference number for my insurance?
A crime reference number is the number of your report.
lines.zh: crime reference number 就是你這個案件的編號。

lines.say: Your insurance and your bank will both ask for it. In Ireland it's also called a Pulse number.
lines.zh: 保險公司和銀行都會要。在愛爾蘭也叫 Pulse number。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could I get a crime reference number for my insurance?

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I'll need a copy of the report to replace my passport.
scenes.meaning: 我需要一份報案紀錄，才能補辦護照

lines.say: And if your passport is gone, you need paper too.
lines.zh: 如果護照不見了，你還需要紙本。

lines.say: I'll need a copy of the report to replace my passport.
To replace something means to get a new one.
lines.zh: replace 是換一個新的，也就是補辦。

lines.say: Your embassy or office will ask for the police report first.
lines.zh: 你的大使館或辦事處會先跟你要報案紀錄。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'll need a copy of the report to replace my passport.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: Do you think it might have been caught on CCTV?
scenes.meaning: 你覺得有可能被監視器拍到嗎？
scenes.note: might have been ＝ 可能已經被……

lines.say: Buses and stations have cameras. So ask.
lines.zh: 公車和車站都有攝影機，所以要問。

lines.say: Do you think it might have been caught on CCTV?
CCTV means security cameras. Might have been caught means: maybe it was recorded.
lines.zh: CCTV 是監視器。might have been caught 是「可能已經被拍到」。

lines.say: Ask quickly. Many places delete the video after a few weeks.
lines.zh: 要快點問，很多地方幾週後就會刪掉影片。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Do you think it might have been caught on CCTV?
Part four: what happens next.
lines.zh: 第四段：問後續。

lines.say: You've reported it. Now make sure you're not just waiting in the dark.
lines.zh: 案報完了。接下來要確保自己不是摸黑乾等。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Is there anything else I should do in the meantime?
scenes.meaning: 這段時間我還需要做什麼嗎？
scenes.note: in the meantime ＝ 在這段期間

lines.say: Is there anything else I should do in the meantime?
In the meantime means while I'm waiting.
lines.zh: in the meantime 是在等待的這段期間。

lines.say: They'll usually tell you to cancel your cards and lock your phone.
lines.zh: 對方通常會叫你停卡、鎖手機。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Is there anything else I should do in the meantime?

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: How will I be kept updated?
scenes.meaning: 之後有進展會怎麼通知我？
scenes.note: be kept updated ＝ 持續得到最新消息

lines.say: Then ask how you'll hear news.
lines.zh: 接著問怎麼得到消息。

lines.say: How will I be kept updated?
To be kept updated means someone keeps giving you the latest news.
lines.zh: be kept updated 是有人持續告訴你最新進度。

lines.say: It's the passive again: I will be kept updated. You don't need to say by who.
lines.zh: 又是被動語態：I will be kept updated，不用說是誰通知。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: How will I be kept updated?

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Thanks for your help. I really appreciate it.
scenes.meaning: 謝謝你的幫忙，真的很感謝

lines.say: And finish warmly. The garda is on your side.
lines.zh: 最後溫暖地結束，警察是站在你這邊的。

lines.say: Thanks for your help. I really appreciate it.
I really appreciate it is stronger and warmer than thank you.
lines.zh: I really appreciate it 比 thank you 更強烈、更有溫度。

lines.say: People help more when they feel appreciated. That's true in every country.
lines.zh: 人被感謝時會更願意幫忙，這在每個國家都一樣。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Thanks for your help. I really appreciate it.
Could I get a crime reference number for my insurance?
lines.zh: 可以給我報案編號嗎？保險要用。

lines.say: Of course. I'll write it down for you now.
lines.zh: 當然，我現在寫給你。

lines.say: Do you think it might have been caught on CCTV?
lines.zh: 有沒有可能被監視器拍到？

lines.say: Good question. We'll ask the bus company today.
lines.zh: 問得好，我們今天就問公車公司。

lines.say: And how will I be kept updated?
lines.zh: 那之後有進展會怎麼通知我？

lines.say: We'll ring you. And cancel your cards in the meantime.
lines.zh: 我們會打電話給你。這段時間先把卡停掉。

lines.say: Thanks for your help. I really appreciate it.
lines.zh: 謝謝你的幫忙，真的很感謝。

lines.say: That took two minutes, not twenty.
lines.zh: 這次只花兩分鐘，不是二十分鐘。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：包包被偷的兩種說法

lines.say: One more thing! Two words you'll hear when you tell your Irish friends.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！你跟愛爾蘭朋友講這件事時，會聽到的兩個字。

lines.say: Your textbook says a bag is stolen, and a person is robbed. But in Ireland, people say this about things too.
lines.zh: 課本說東西用 stolen、人才用 robbed。但愛爾蘭人講東西也這樣說。

lines.say: My bag was robbed.
It's not textbook English, but you'll hear it everywhere. Use stolen with the garda, and robbed with your friends.
lines.zh: 這不是課本英文，但到處都聽得到。跟警察說 stolen，跟朋友說 robbed。

lines.say: And your friends will answer with this.
lines.zh: 然後你朋友會這樣回。

lines.say: That's desperate!
Here, desperate means terrible, really bad. It shows they feel sorry for you.
lines.zh: 在這裡 desperate 是很糟、很慘，表示他們替你難過。

lines.say: That's desperate!
Now let's report it again, the right way. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 現在用對的方法重新報一次案。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: Garda station, how can I help?
lines.zh: 這裡是警察局，有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

lines.say: I'd like to report a theft. My bag was stolen on the bus about an hour ago.
lines.zh: 我要報案。我的包包大約一小時前在公車上被偷了。

lines.say: I'm sorry to hear that. Did you see it happen?
lines.zh: 很遺憾聽到這件事。你有看到過程嗎？

lines.say: No. I only realised it was gone when I got off.
lines.zh: 沒有，我下車的時候才發現不見了。

lines.say: OK. Let's take the details.
lines.zh: 好，我們來記錄細節。

lines.say: I'll need a copy of the report to replace my passport.
lines.zh: 我需要一份報案紀錄，才能補辦護照。

lines.say: No problem. You'll have it before you leave.
lines.zh: 沒問題，你離開前就會拿到。

items: I'd like to report a theft.
My bag was stolen on the bus about an hour ago.
I only realised it was gone when I got off.
It's a small black leather backpack with a broken zip.
It had my passport, my wallet and my phone in it.
I didn't get a good look at him, but he was wearing a grey hoodie.
Could I get a crime reference number for my insurance?
I'll need a copy of the report to replace my passport.
Do you think it might have been caught on CCTV?
Is there anything else I should do in the meantime?
How will I be kept updated?
Thanks for your help. I really appreciate it.

lines.say: Well done. Calm, clear, and nothing forgotten.
lines.zh: 做得好。冷靜、清楚，而且什麼都沒漏。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Take a screenshot and keep it on your phone. Just not only on your phone!
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡，截圖存在手機裡。但不要只存在手機裡！

lines.say: Before you go! Do you want to practise English a little every day?
lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.say: Try BinBin. Every day, there's a short news story from where you live, with the hard words explained.
lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.say: Then play quick word games, on your own or with your friends.
lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: Keep your streak going, unlock new titles, and say hi to other learners in the plaza.
lines.zh: 保持連續打卡、解鎖新稱號，還能在廣場跟其他學習者打招呼。

lines.say: And there are more lessons like this one, right inside the app.
lines.zh: App 裡還有更多像這樣的英文小教室。

lines.say: Go to binbindaily dot com, or tap the link below.
lines.zh: 上 binbindaily.com，或點下面的連結。
lines.cap: Go to binbindaily.com, or tap the link below.

lines.say: And did I get my bag back? I did! But that's a story for another day. Bye!
lines.zh: 那我的包包有找回來嗎？有！不過那是另一個故事了。Bye！
